query: What screen or touch-response issues do iPhone X reviewers describe?

chunks.text: Unexpected Touchscreen Issues. While the iPhone X provides numerous features that are improvements over the previous models, it exhibits some problems with touchscreen functioning while the battery is charging. This results in one of two undesired behaviors: 1) Portions of the screen not responding to touch. This is usually in the upper corners. 2) Greatly delayed response to touch such that the screen does not appear to respond at all followed by periods where the screen seems to be under the control of some outside force because multiple actions take place in rapid succession that completely ignore any actual touch commands being made in the moment. Best response is achieved by limiting interaction while the phone is charging.

chunks.text: Touch Screen Did Not Work. Unfortunately I was never able to set this phobe up because of a malfunction with the touch screen, and software issues. I did call Kiss Electronics first to get technical support but they said no support was available. At the same point in the setup, while trying to accept or reject the agreement with apple, the phone would freeze, the touch screen stopped working, and the only option was to force shut down and restart again. Unfortunately, without being able to set the phone up it was not usable and needed to be returned/refunded. I would not purchase from Kiss Electronics again, as any reasonable person could have checked this error before the phone was sold.
